items.name: Northern Iron Broadsword
items.description: A wide, heavy double-edged broadsword forged from Valenfrost river-iron. Reliable and deadly in the hands of a hold warrior.

items.name: Honed Iron Broadsword
items.description: Carefully whetted with coarse mountain stone. Its mirror edge cleaves through wolf fur and quilted gambesons.

items.name: Silver-Inlaid Waraxe
items.description: Forged with dwarven silver inlay along the bearded beard-edge. Undead wights and draugr shriek when struck by its silver bite.

items.name: Rime-Wood Longbow
items.description: A tall yew-backed ash recurve crafted by scout bowyers. Penetrates heavy hides at long distances.

items.name: Scout's Hunting Dagger
items.description: A sharp bone-hilted utility blade used for field dressing game, cutting ropes, and silent throat-strikes.

items.name: Huscarl's Greataxe
items.description: A massive two-handed executioner's greataxe carried by the Jarl's personal huscarl guard. Devastating on charging foes.

items.name: Rune-Carved Glacial Blade
items.description: Etched with archaic winter runes that glow pale blue. Wreathed in frost vapors that numb enemy parrying arms.

items.name: Wyrmtooth Boar Spear
items.description: Tipped with the fossilized tooth of a young ice drake. Can pierce through troll hide and scale with frightening ease.

items.name: Fang of the Star-Father
items.description: The ancient ancestral blade of High King Valen, forged from pure meteoric sky-iron. Glows like falling lightning in the presence of wyrms.

items.name: Whispering Stiletto
items.description: A needle-thin black steel stiletto favoured by the cutpurses of Mistglen for slipping past armor seams.

items.name: Huscarl's Reinforced Roundshield
items.description: Hardened pine planks bound in iron rim with a heavy central boss. Blunts heavy axe strikes and arrows.

items.name: Silver-Crested Tower Shield
items.description: A towering dwarven heater shield bearing the silver pickaxe sigil of the Silver Kin. Repels physical blows and magical frost.

items.name: Northern Ringmail Hauberk
items.description: Interlinked iron rings riveted over thick quilted wool. Standard field panoply of the hold garrison.

items.name: Ranger's Waxed Leather Coat
items.description: Treated elk-skin leather reinforced with horn plates. Silent, flexible, and weather-resistant.

items.name: Skald's Silver-Threaded Ringmail
items.description: Supple chain hauberk interwoven with silver wire, tailored for swift chanting and blade-dancing.

items.name: Winter Wolf Warm-Cloak
items.description: A thick pelt of snowy white mountain wolf lined with wool. Keeps bitter winds from chilling muscle and bone.

items.name: Silver Kin Forged Cuirass
items.description: Flawlessly articulated heavy breastplate forged from tempered coal-steel by clan smiths in the Blackforge.

items.name: Northern Spangenhelm
items.description: Conical iron helm fitted with an ocular spectacle mask and protective cheek plates.

items.name: Fur-Lined Mountain Boots
items.description: Heavy treaded leather boots fitted with iron cleats for traversing frozen mountain scree.

items.name: Salt-Cured Mountain Venison
items.description: Hearty strips of venison smoked over pine embers. Sustains hunters on grueling climbs.

items.name: Cold-Smoked Fjord Salmon
items.description: Rich, oily pink salmon cured in juniper salt. A favorite of Mistglen boatmen.

items.name: Caravan Hardtack Biscuit
items.description: Dense, dry barley biscuits baked to endure months in pack sacks without spoiling.

items.name: Valenfrost Spiced Juniper Mead
items.description: Sweet, intoxicating golden mead fermented with wild clover honey and crushed mountain juniper.

items.name: Juniper Stamina Cordial
items.description: A brisk herbal draught distilled from blue glacier lichen. Clears mental fatigue and restores vigour.

items.name: Elixir of the Hearthfire
items.description: A glowing amber brew that fills the veins with gentle warmth, nullifying freezing chill.

items.name: Master Alchemist's Restorative
items.description: A concentrated dual draught of distilled herbs that knits torn sinew and mends cracked bone.

items.name: Mire Viper Venom Gland
items.description: A harvested venom sac from a marsh viper. Can be smeared upon blade edges to inflict lethal poisoning.

items.name: Dwarven Tension Lockpicks
items.description: A roll of finely tempered steel picks and torsion wrenches crafted for bypassing heavy iron tumblers.

items.name: Pitch-Soaked Pine Torch
items.description: Burns with a bright, smoky resin flare for hours inside damp barrows and caverns.

items.name: Granite Mountain Whetstone
items.description: Fine-grained whetstone quarried from high peaks. Perfect for putting a razor edge on iron and steel weapons.

items.name: Master Smith's Rounding Hammer
items.description: Heavy balance hammer required for forging weapons and shaping plates at an anvil.

items.name: Portable Copper Alembic Kit
items.description: Tubing, glass phials, and a copper retort for distilling mountain herbs and monster extracts.

items.name: Furrier's Scraper & Awl Set
items.description: Curved scrapers, bone needles, and sinew thread used to work pelts and beast hides.

items.name: Carved Obsidian Rune Focus
items.description: A polished volcanic glass token inscribed with the storm glyph of Torvald. Enhances spellcasting resonance.

items.name: Iron Key of Grimstone Vault
items.description: A heavy, square-toothed iron key recovered from the dwarven overseer's office in Grimstone Mine.

items.name: Silver Key of the Winter Spire
items.description: A delicately chased silver key granting access to the locked arcanum vaults of Frostmere Spire.

items.name: Ancient Runic Barrow Key
items.description: Carved from petrified bog oak and tipped with bronze. Unlocks the inner burial crypt of Skallagrim.

items.name: Star-Key of the Eastern Peak
items.description: First of the three celestial runic tablets forged by High King Valen to seal the crater of Mount Wyrmfang.

items.name: Star-Key of the Glacial Spire
items.description: Second of the three celestial runic tablets, safeguarded within the archives of Frostmere Spire.

items.name: Star-Key of the Sunken Barrow
items.description: Third of the three celestial runic tablets, entombed with Chieftain Skallagrim in the deep crypts.

items.name: Signet of the Wolf Crest
items.description: Stolen from Jarl Sigurd's chambers. Bearing the roaring wolf head of Valenfrost in hammered gold.

items.name: Cabal's Smuggling Ledger
items.description: A cipher-filled oilcloth ledger recording bribes, warehouse caches, and shipments between Mistglen and Valenfrost.

items.name: Engraved Ancient Silver Chalice
items.description: An antique drinking vessel adorned with intertwined knotwork, recovered from a burial barrow.

items.name: Baltic Amber Bead Necklace
items.description: Golden translucent fossil resin beads washed ashore along the northern sea coast.

items.name: Garnet-Studded Cloak Clasp
items.description: A bronze disk brooch set with deep red cabochon garnets in geometric clan patterns.
